visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens inside a modern barbecue restaurant with warm wooden textures. A male staff member wearing a red beanie and a black t-shirt with text on the back is busy at a table. Several other customers are seated in the background. Black exhaust pipes are positioned above the tables. (2) Close-up shots of hands wearing black gloves. One hand uses a large chef's knife to slice through a thick slab of raw, highly marbled beef on a white plastic cutting board. Another shot shows a brush spreading a yellow-brown marinade over beef slices in a metal tray. (3) A male host wearing a white baseball cap and a grey jacket is seen speaking in an indoor setting with shelves of bottles behind him. He uses expressive hand gestures while talking. The lighting is bright and even. (4) Various shots of raw and grilled meat. Tongs pick up slices of beef with white marbling and place them on a hot wire mesh over coals. White smoke rises as the meat sizzles. Different cuts, including thick pieces and thin strips, are displayed on plates and bamboo mats. (5) A black bowl containing white rice is topped with green onions and a bright orange raw egg yolk. Tongs place a piece of grilled meat on top. A pair of chopsticks then breaks and mixes the yolk into the rice. (6) Further food details: raw liver is shown in a small bowl, grilled, and dipped in sauce. Thick-cut beef tongue is grilled. Beef tartare with a raw egg yolk and cucumber strips is mixed. (7) Production shots showing a scale, a beer tap pouring golden liquid with white foam into a glass branded with Asahi, and hot soup being poured from a black kettle into a bowl. (8) The video concludes with an exterior shot of the restaurant showing a large white curtain with Japanese/Chinese calligraphy and the logo on a wall inside a hallway.

It highlights the restaurant's connection to Japanese farms, the high quality of the meat (Wagyu), and specific signature dishes like raw egg rice, liver, and tongue to entice viewers to visit.
